historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved as amended the authorization to deduct up to 44,450 square feet of office space from the annual limit for a new five-story building with office, retail and parking space.
The site was vacant except for two billboards that were to be removed.
The City Planning Commission approved with conditions the conditional use for off-street parking spaces above the accessory amount for the new five-story building.
The City Planning Commission approved with conditions the Section 309 determinations of compliance for the new five-story building.
